blocks.text: Technology helps entrepreneurs solve real-world problems in faster and more efficient ways. It allows people to create digital solutions for challenges in education, healthcare, agriculture, and business (as shown in Figure 9.4). For example, online learning platforms help students study from home, while mobile apps support farmers in improving crop production. Digital payment systems make financial transactions easier and safer. By using technology creatively, entrepreneurs can develop innovative solutions that improve people’s daily lives.
